title: OneDrive: improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive on the web
summary: Hold: the briefing treats the need for a Copilot licence as unpublished even though Microsoft documents the product-level requirement and includes OneDrive integration in it. Separate terms and the relationship to Advanced work in OneDrive remain unconfirmed, but that does not make the general licence requirement unknown. The roadmap facts and the four documented control paths and commands are supported.
